# Springer
> Global academic and scientific publisher offering journals, books, reference works, and publishing services across research disciplines.

Springer is part of Springer Nature and provides access to scholarly content, author services, journal information, books, and open access publishing resources for researchers, librarians, educators, and institutions.

## Journals
- [Journals A-Z](https://link.springer.com/journals/a/1): Browse Springer journals alphabetically across disciplines and subject areas.
- [Find a Journal](https://www.springer.com/gp/authors-editors/journal-author/journal-author-helpdesk/find-journal): Search tools and guidance for selecting an appropriate journal.
- [Journal Collections](https://link.springer.com/journals): Explore Springer journal titles and subject-based journal listings.
- [Open Access Journals](https://www.springeropen.com/journals): Discover SpringerOpen fully open access journals and subject collections.
- [Medicine Journals](https://link.springer.com/medicine/journals): Browse medical and health sciences journals on SpringerLink.
- [Life Sciences Journals](https://link.springer.com/life-sciences/journals): Access life sciences journal listings and subject coverage.
- [Physics Journals](https://link.springer.com/physics/journals): Explore physics journals spanning theoretical and applied research.

## Books and Reference Works
- [Books A-Z](https://link.springer.com/books/a/1): Browse Springer books alphabetically across all publishing subjects.
- [Book Series](https://link.springer.com/book-series): Explore ongoing Springer book series and thematic collections.
- [Reference Works](https://link.springer.com/referencework): Access encyclopedias, handbooks, and major reference publications.
- [Computer Science Books](https://link.springer.com/computer-science/books): Browse computer science books and monographs.
- [Engineering Books](https://link.springer.com/engineering/books): Explore engineering books covering research and professional practice.
- [Mathematics Books](https://link.springer.com/mathematics/books): Access mathematics books, textbooks, and advanced monographs.
- [Behavioral Science Books](https://link.springer.com/behavioral-sciences/books): Browse behavioral sciences books and scholarly titles.

## SpringerLink Content Platform
- [SpringerLink](https://link.springer.com/): Main platform for accessing Springer journals, books, chapters, and reference content.
- [Advanced Search](https://link.springer.com/advanced-search): Search SpringerLink content with detailed filters and field options.
- [Browse by Discipline](https://link.springer.com/browse): Navigate content by subject and publication type.
- [Latest Research](https://link.springer.com/search?facet-content-type=%22Article%22&showAll=false): Discover recently published research articles on SpringerLink.
- [Chapters](https://link.springer.com/search?facet-content-type=%22Chapter%22&showAll=false): Browse book chapters available through SpringerLink.
- [Protocols](https://experiments.springernature.com/): Access Springer Nature Experiments protocols and methods content.

## Authors and Editors
- [Authors & Editors](https://www.springer.com/gp/authors-editors): Central hub for publishing guidance, tools, and services.
- [Journal Author Helpdesk](https://www.springer.com/gp/authors-editors/journal-author): Resources for submitting and publishing in Springer journals.
- [Book Authors](https://www.springer.com/gp/authors-editors/book-authors-editors): Guidance for writing, proposing, and publishing Springer books.
- [Open Access Publishing](https://www.springer.com/gp/open-access): Information on Springer open access options and policies.
- [Manuscript Submission Guidelines](https://www.springer.com/gp/authors-editors/journal-author/journal-author-helpdesk/before-you-start): Prepare manuscripts and understand submission requirements.
- [Author Tutorials](https://www.springer.com/gp/authors-editors/authorandreviewertutorials): Tutorials for authors and reviewers using Springer workflows.
- [Rights and Permissions](https://www.springer.com/gp/rights-permissions): Manage permissions, reuse requests, and licensing information.

## Open Access
- [SpringerOpen](https://www.springeropen.com/): Open access publishing platform for journals, books, and article collections.
- [Open Choice](https://www.springer.com/gp/open-access/springer-open-choice): Hybrid open access option for subscription journals.
- [Open Access Books](https://www.springer.com/gp/open-access/books): Information about publishing and accessing open access books.
- [Open Access Journals](https://www.springeropen.com/journals): Browse fully open access journals by subject.
- [APCs and Funding](https://www.springer.com/gp/open-access/publication-fees): Learn about article processing charges and funding support.
- [Open Access Policies](https://www.springer.com/gp/open-access/policies): Review Springer open access policies and compliance information.

## Librarians and Institutions
- [Librarians](https://www.springer.com/gp/librarians): Resources for collection development, access, and institutional services.
- [Products for Institutions](https://www.springer.com/gp/products): Overview of Springer products and content packages for institutions.
- [Journals Collections for Libraries](https://www.springer.com/gp/librarians/products/journals): Information on journal subscriptions and collections for libraries.
- [eBooks for Libraries](https://www.springer.com/gp/librarians/products/ebooks): Details on Springer eBook collections and acquisition models.
- [Databases and Reference Works](https://www.springer.com/gp/librarians/products/databases): Explore databases and major reference products for institutions.
- [Library Marketing Toolkit](https://www.springer.com/gp/librarians/the-link/blog/blogposts/library-marketing-toolkit): Promotional resources to support library awareness and usage.
- [Metadata and Discovery](https://www.springer.com/gp/librarians/metadata): Access metadata services and discovery support information.

## Researchers and Subject Areas
- [Medicine](https://link.springer.com/medicine): Research content in medicine and clinical disciplines.
- [Life Sciences](https://link.springer.com/life-sciences): Journals, books, and reference works in life sciences.
- [Chemistry](https://link.springer.com/chemistry): Access chemistry research publications and subject collections.
- [Physics](https://link.springer.com/physics): Explore physics content across journals, books, and reference works.
- [Mathematics](https://link.springer.com/mathematics): Browse mathematics publications and scholarly resources.
- [Computer Science](https://link.springer.com/computer-science): Access computer science journals, books, and conference proceedings.
- [Engineering](https://link.springer.com/engineering): Explore engineering research and technical publications.
- [Humanities and Social Sciences](https://link.springer.com/humanities-and-social-sciences): Browse humanities and social sciences scholarly content.

## Publishing Policies and Support
- [Editorial Policies](https://www.springer.com/gp/editorial-policies): Policies covering ethics, peer review, and editorial standards.
- [Research Integrity](https://www.springer.com/gp/editorial-policies/research-integrity): Guidance on integrity, misconduct, and publication ethics.
- [Peer Review](https://www.springer.com/gp/reviewers/peer-review): Overview of peer review models and reviewer expectations.
- [Copyright and Licensing](https://www.springer.com/gp/open-access/publication-process/copyright-transfer): Information on copyright transfer and licensing arrangements.
- [Permissions](https://www.springer.com/gp/rights-permissions/permissions): Request and manage permissions for Springer content reuse.
- [Policies for Books](https://www.springer.com/gp/editorial-policies/book-policies): Editorial and ethical policies relevant to book publishing.

## Help and Account Services
- [Customer Support](https://support.springer.com/): Support portal for access, orders, accounts, and publishing queries.
- [Springer Nature Support](https://support.springernature.com/): Help center covering Springer Nature products and services.
- [Order History and Account Help](https://support.springer.com/en/support/solutions): Find solutions for account, payment, and order-related issues.
- [Contact Us](https://www.springer.com/gp/help/contact-us): Contact options for Springer customer and publishing support.
- [FAQ](https://support.springer.com/en/support/home): Browse frequently asked questions and support topics.
- [Librarian Support](https://support.springernature.com/en/support/solutions/folders/6000238519): Support resources for librarians and institutional administrators.

## News and Insights
- [The Link](https://www.springer.com/gp/librarians/the-link): Springer blog and updates for librarians and information professionals.
- [Springer Nature News](https://group.springernature.com/gp/group/media/press-releases): Press releases and corporate news from Springer Nature.
- [Open Research Blog](https://www.springernature.com/gp/researchers/the-source/blog): Articles and insights for researchers and authors.
- [Author and Reviewer Tutorials](https://www.springer.com/gp/authors-editors/authorandreviewertutorials): Educational materials supporting publishing workflows.
- [Publishing Insights](https://www.springer.com/gp/authors-editors/authorandreviewertutorials/publishing-tutorials): Tutorials and practical guidance on scholarly publishing.
